premise: Beaver finds the biggest stick in the forest stuck fast in the meadow; Bear cub pulls, Rabbit pulls Bear cub, and only when tiny Mouse joins — POP! — out it comes and they tumble in a heap.
inspiration: The Enormous Turnip (Russian folk), turned with a stick, a count of pullers and a heap of giggles — and the smallest puller's proud last word.
lesson: Every helper counts, even the smallest.

en-US.title: The Stick That Would Not Budge
en-US.text: {beaver:enter} Beaver found the best stick in the whole forest, stuck fast in the ground. {beaver:face happy} [excited] Just what I need! He pulled and he pulled. {beaver:shake} Heave-ho! But the stick wouldn't budge. Along came {bear:enter} Bear cub. {bear:go to beaver} I'll help! Two pulling now. {bear:shake} Heave-ho! It wouldn't budge. {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came hopping. {rabbit:go to bear} Three pulling now. {rabbit:shake} Heave-ho! Still it wouldn't budge. {beaver:face sad} [sighs] Then tiny {mouse:enter} Mouse scampered up to see what the fuss was. {mouse:live} He sniffed. Can I help? {bear:face surprised} You? said Bear cub. You're so small! {mouse:go to rabbit} Mouse pulled Rabbit, Rabbit pulled Bear cub, Bear cub pulled Beaver, Beaver pulled the stick. Four pulling now! HEAVE… HO! {sfx:pop} POP! {beaver:spin} {bear:spin} {rabbit:spin} {mouse:spin} Out came the stick, and {sfx:tumble} down they tumbled in a heap. {all:face happy} [laughs] {beaver:live hold} Beaver held up his stick. Who pulled it out? asked Rabbit. [giggles] We all did, squeaked Mouse. {mouse:hop x2} I just pulled LAST.

es-ES.title: El palo que no se movía
es-ES.text: {beaver:enter} Castor encontró el mejor palo de todo el bosque, bien clavado en el suelo. {beaver:face happy} [excited] ¡Justo lo que necesito! Tiró y tiró. {beaver:shake} ¡Aúpa! Pero el palo no se movía. Llegó {bear:enter} Osito. {bear:go to beaver} ¡Te ayudo! Ya tiraban dos. {bear:shake} ¡Aúpa! Y nada, no se movía. {rabbit:enter} Conejo llegó saltando. {rabbit:go to bear} Ya tiraban tres. {rabbit:shake} ¡Aúpa! Y el palo, ni se movía. {beaver:face sad} [sighs] Entonces el pequeño {mouse:enter} Ratón se acercó a ver qué pasaba. {mouse:live} Olfateó. ¿Os ayudo? {bear:face surprised} ¿Tú? dijo Osito. ¡Si eres muy pequeño! {mouse:go to rabbit} Ratón tiró de Conejo, Conejo tiró de Osito, Osito tiró de Castor, y Castor tiró del palo. ¡Ya tiraban cuatro! ¡A… ÚPA! {sfx:pop} ¡PLOP! {beaver:spin} {bear:spin} {rabbit:spin} {mouse:spin} Salió el palo, y {sfx:tumble} todos rodaron por la hierba, unos encima de otros. {all:face happy} [laughs] {beaver:live hold} Castor levantó su palo. ¿Quién lo ha sacado? preguntó Conejo. [giggles] Todos, dijo Ratón con su vocecita. {mouse:hop x2} Yo solo he tirado el ÚLTIMO.

pop.prompt: a big comic pop as a stuck stick comes out of the ground, playful

tumble.prompt: a soft thump and rustle of friends tumbling together into long grass, gentle
